title: Positive tensor powers preserve absolute ampleness
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and k a positive natural number. If M is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], then its kth tensor power is ample.

proof.text: Retain compactness and choose n > 0, a section s of M.tensorPow n, and its affine nonvanishing open U at the point. Form f = homOfGlobalSection s and t = tensorPowSectionOne f k. The tensorPowMulIso isomorphisms and Nat.mul_comm identify (M.tensorPow n).tensorPow k with (M.tensorPow k).tensorPow n.

Use the upstream private nonvanishing_of_frame helper: the stalk of a local free generator freely generates, by bijective_smul_germ from [lem-weil-pbc-section-nonvanishing-zero-locus], so a section with coefficient a is nonvanishing precisely when the germ of a is a unit. The proved exists_tensorPowSectionOne_eq_pow_smul gives coefficient a^k for t. Restriction compatibility, map_pow and isUnit_pow_iff hk.ne' show nonvanishingLocus t = nonvanishingLocus s.

Transport t through the tensor-power isomorphism e. The upstream private nonvanishingLocus_iso from [lem-sc-ample-iso] preserves its locus. The original n, U and the transported section therefore witness ampleness at the point, retaining compactness. This is the existing complete upstream proof; the Sheaf copy is retired.

proof_origin.note: S4 retirement: attach the existing complete upstream proof, using a local frame, unit detection of nonvanishing, positive powers, and isomorphism invariance; no new theorem or sorry.
